text:
anya: FYI I just ran a preview for a weight shift to Model-B (route /gen-chat) and the consolefast estimate showed +12% cost but our staging replays show ~+2%.

tom: That screams fast-mode overestimate. Fast-mode assumes independent tokens, no KV/prefix cache and no request coalescing.

sarah: Right. We have two estimate engines: quick_sim (cheap) and replay_sim (expensive but models batching and cache). Console currently surfaces quick_sim only.

devx-lee: UX ask: make the estimate mode visible and surface both numbers when available: "Quick estimate: +12% (fast) — Final estimate: +2% (includes batching & cache)". Show a loading spinner for final.

anya: Also noticed preview doesn't show per-route or per-model quota headroom. The preview summary says "account quota ok" but route-level quotas would be blown for some customers.

eng-analytics: Implementation note: our preview samples 50k requests from last 24h but we don't run cohort hashing or apply the same per-route sampling used in rollout. That explains mismatch.

tom: Proposed flow: 1) console triggers /v1/preview?mode=quick which returns a preview_job_id and quick numbers; 2) server enqueues a replay_sim job bound to preview_job_id which emits a final estimate when done; 3) console subscribes via /v1/preview/{id}/status to get final result.

anya: Love it. Make sure preview_job_id is included in logs so the replay tool can pick the identical trace window. Right now replay picks a window by time only.

eng-analytics: We'll change the replay selection to use preview_job_id -> maps to trace_window_id. Also we'll replay through the same hashing and cohort assignment code path.

devx-lee: For the promote API: POST /v1/configs/promote currently returns {summary}. Can we extend it with a recommendations array and a telemetry_recommendations object? e.g., "telemetry_recommendations": {"trace_rate": "10%", "p99_tail_sampling": "increase from 1% to 20%"}. Console will render these in an "Ops guidance" card.

tom: We should also return a risk_score and a confidence_interval for the cost delta. E.g., cost_delta: +2%, ci: [-1%, +5%]. That helps PMs decide whether to proceed.

anya: Important: surface per-model quota impact like "model-B headroom 28% -> 6% after rollout". If headroom < 10% show a warning and recommended mitigations.

ops-bot: preview-bot: job 1796001234 queued for replay_sim. estimated runtime 30s.

eng-analytics: One more thing on sampling: to make telemetry actionable we can include recommended temporary sampling overrides in the promote response, plus a short-circuit `ops_playbook_url`. Example: {"telemetry_recommendations": [{"metric":"tail_latency_p99","from":"1%","to":"15%","duration":"10m"}], "ops_playbook_url":"https://redwood.internal/playbooks/model-quota"}.

devx-lee: UX note: don't show raw JSON. put a one-click "apply sampling" button that calls /v1/ops/override-sampling (auth required). Also store an audit event showing who applied the override.

anya: Action items: eng-analytics: wire replay to use preview_job_id + cohort hashing and emit confidence interval; tom: implement preview_job_id lifecycle + status endpoint; devx-lee: mockups for dual-estimate UI and ops guidance card; ops: add apply-sampling endpoint and audit event.

tom: I'll add a small experiment: for large accounts (>100M tokens/day) we default to async final estimate, for small accounts we can run final estimate inline.

anya: Thanks folks. Once the final estimate lands I'll run a staging promote and compare production replay to the preview numbers.

ops-bot: preview-bot: job 1796001234 completed. final_estimate: +1.8% (ci -0.9%..+4.7%). replay_trace_id=rt-2026-11-19-1796.

devx-lee: Nice. I'll update the mock to show both values and a "why they differ" tooltip.
